# Security policy

## Supported versions

The latest minor release receives security fixes. Older minor releases are
end-of-life once a newer one ships.

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please do not open a public issue for a security problem. Report it privately
through GitHub security advisories, or by email to security@example.invalid.

We acknowledge a report within two business days and aim to publish a fix, or an
explanation of why one is not needed, within thirty days.
